SELECT tl.*, COALESCE (tlst.today_pv, 0) AS todayPv, COALESCE (tlst.today_uv, 0) AS todayUv, COALESCE (tlst.today_uip, 0) AS todayUip FROM t_link tl LEFT JOIN t_link_stats_today tlst ON tl.full_short_url = tlst.full_short_url AND tlst.date = CURDATE() WHERE tl.gid = #{gid} AND tl.enable_status = 0 AND tl.del_flag = 0
ORDER BY todayPv DESC
ORDER BY todayUv DESC
ORDER BY todayUip DESC
ORDER BY tl.total_uv DESC
ORDER BY tl.total_pv DESC
ORDER BY tl.total_uip DESC
ORDER BY tl.create_time DESC
